text: マニアという　だけに　いろいろ　めずらしい　ポケモンを　もってる　らしい

structure.jp: マニアという　だけに
structure.en: just as you'd expect of someone called a maniac

structure.jp: いろいろ　めずらしい　ポケモンを　もってる　らしい
structure.en: he apparently has all sorts of rare Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜だけに
patterns.span: マニアという　だけに
patterns.explanation: だけに means 'precisely because of that, as you would expect'. マニアという　だけに = 'as you'd expect of someone called a maniac'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end means 'apparently, from what I hear'. もってる　らしい = 'apparently he has'.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: という after a word means 'called' or 'said to be' that. マニアという = 'called a maniac'.
